stories.title: Nepal: Families cling to hope as nearly 1,000 remain missing
stories.summary: Nepal's confirmed death toll has risen to at least 538, but families are still searching hospitals and disaster zones in the hope their loved ones will be found alive, with nearly 1,000 people still missing. More than 3,700 people have been rescued so far, though destroyed roads, bridges and thick mud continue to hamper search efforts.

stories.title: Unifil records 1,030 projectile launches in south Lebanon in a week
stories.summary: Unifil records 1,030 projectile launches in south Lebanon in a week Levels of violence are lower than earlier this year, but the situation in south Lebanon "remains fragile," the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (Unifil) has warned on Friday. The peacekeeping force said that between 21-27 August, it recorded 1,030 projectile trajectories in the area, an average of 147 per day. “Behind these numbers is a continuing toll on civilians, with homes and vital infrastructure damaged and communities struggling to recover,” Unifil said.

stories.title: Guests from Indonesia, Mongolia, Myanmar, China to address EEF alongside Putin — aide
stories.summary: The Eastern Economic Forum will be held in Vladivostok on September 1 through 4
article_sentences: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto, Mongolian Prime Minister Nyam-Osoryn Uchral, Vice-President of Myanmar Nyo Saw and Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang wil deliver speeches at the plenary session of the Eastern Economic Forum (EEF) on September 3, Russian Presidential Aide Yury Ushakov said on Friday.

"Alongside Russian President Vladimir Putin, it [the plenary session] will be attended by Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto, Mongolian Prime Minister Nyam-Osoryn Uchral, Vice-President of Myanmar Nyo Saw, and Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang," Ushakov told journalists.
The Eastern Economic Forum (EEF) will be held in Vladivostok on September 1 through 4.
The main theme of the 2026 forum is "Developing the Far East for the Benefit of Its People." The forum is organized by the Roscongress Foundation with the support of the Russian government.
TASS is the forum’s general media partner.
